description: Schema for the custom-app Eventstream source that ingests AGC telemetry produced by simulator/agc_simulator.py (data/telemetry_stream.ndjson) into a Microsoft Fabric Eventstream, landing in an Eventhouse KQL database table 'AgcTelemetry'.

eventstream_source.name: apollo11-agc-source
eventstream_source.notes: In Fabric, create an Eventstream, add a 'Custom App' source, and copy its connection string. Point a small forwarder at data/telemetry_stream.ndjson (e.g. `tail -f` piped to the Event Hub-compatible endpoint) or use the Fabric Python SDK / azure-eventhub package to publish each NDJSON line as an event.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: program | alarm | restart | note | event | telemetry_sample

columns.name: code
columns.description: Alarm code such as 1202 or 1201, null otherwise

columns.name: radar_auto_slew
columns.description: True when the rendezvous radar is in AUTO/SLEW, injecting spurious jobs
